title: Wolfia vs. Claude: Why Buy a Security Questionnaire Tool?
summary: Everyone has Claude integrated now. So why buy a security questionnaire tool?
body_markdown:
More security teams are using Claude to answer questionnaires, instead of buying a tool or doing it all by hand. Some of our own customers build AI products and could build this themselves. They still chose Wolfia, because their engineers’ time is better spent on their own product, which they’re experts in, than on keeping a questionnaire setup running.


## Claude is the engine. Wolfia is the complete system.


Wolfia is an AI agent for customer security reviews. It gives security teams the flexibility to start wherever they are, Claude included, and takes them the rest of the way, with every answer carrying its source.


### Answers with a source


Every answer links back to the policy, SOC 2 section or past questionnaire it came from. When there’s no evidence, Wolfia sends the question to someone who knows instead of guessing.


### Current, without the clean-up


Wolfia connects to Drive, Notion, Slack, email and your trust center. When a policy, subprocessor or certificate changes, your answers change with it.


### Every format, every portal


Excel files with tabs and dropdowns, Word, PDF, OneTrust and ServiceNow. Wolfia works with all of them and fills portals through a Chrome extension.


### One answer, every team


Sales, solutions engineers, GRC and legal work from the same approved answers. Ask in Slack, review once, and the same answer goes out every time.


### Better with every model


The hard part was never the prompt. It’s keeping your data governed, sourced and current. Wolfia owns that part, so every new model makes it better.


### Inside Claude, out of the box


Already working in Claude? Connect Wolfia and ask your security questions there, with approved, sourced answers coming from Wolfia.


## The benefits of using Wolfia


- **Nothing to maintain:** no prompts, files or connections for your team to keep alive.
- **Answers you can stand behind:** every one points back to its source.
- **No single expert as the bottleneck:** questions reach the right person in Slack.
- **An engineer from day one:** a dedicated engineer for your first three months.
- **Room for everyone:** unlimited seats for the whole team.


The teams moving fastest on security reviews know the choice today isn’t Claude or a tool. It’s keeping the model they like and adding the system that makes its answers safe to send.


Faster security reviews are built on Wolfia. Want to see it on your own questionnaire?[Let’s talk](https://wolfia.com/demo) .
